code: import{useCallback,useEffect,useState}from'react';import{fetchOrgWallets,transferBetweenWallets}from'../services/vendorHierarchyService';export const useOrgWallets=orgId=>{const[wallets,setWallets]=useState([]);const[loading,setLoading]=useState(false);const[error,setError]=useState(null);const refresh=useCallback(async()=>{if(!orgId){setWallets([]);return;}setLoading(true);setError(null);try{const data=await fetchOrgWallets(orgId);setWallets(data);}catch(err){console.error('Failed to load wallets',err);setError((err===null||err===void 0?void 0:err.message)||'Failed to load wallets');}finally{setLoading(false);}},[orgId]);useEffect(()=>{refresh();},[refresh]);const transfer=useCallback(async(walletId,payload)=>{const result=await transferBetweenWallets(walletId,payload);await refresh();return result;},[refresh]);const totalBalance=wallets.reduce((sum,wallet)=>sum+Number(wallet.balance||0),0);return{wallets,loading,error,refresh,transfer,totalBalance};};
